title: No tracks info received for TS in non-HLS mode
body:
This issue was introduced with changes made in commit: 4f57c46560006f188d6c8cf64aa3d7ffc003368c

Rolling back that changes on top of 8854aa415fbc39def3dfbd9c97d3a25812305999 fixes the problem.

I can reproduce the problem using next setup:
* https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.acestream.media.atv (provides local server which re-streams p2p content via http). Sorry for 3rd party app, but it's a bit difficult to grab it's stream from device itself
* http://localhost:6878/ace/getstream?url=http%3A%2F%2Fcontent.asplaylist.net%2Fcdn%2F334_all.acelive
* NVidia Shield

In 90% of attempts to play stream using Demo Player I do not get tracks info and no playback started.
